cardOverview.overviewText: An ultra-premium Indulge card with a solid gold design, unlimited lounge access, luxury privileges, and concierge services for elite customers.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy B1G1 free on movie tickets (up to 3 times/month, max ₹700/ticket), an additional ₹50 discount on F&B, 25% off on non-movie tickets, and save ₹3,000 twice yearly on dining bills.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: 24×7 concierge service for assistance regarding hotel/flight bookings with this card.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail any of these services, please call the concierge desk at 1860 267 7777.
